description: Pre-built AI workflow templates for professional services firms

workflows.name: Automated Client Intake
workflows.description: Connect website form to CRM to practice management — zero manual data entry
workflows.trigger: New client inquiry via website form or email
steps: Capture intake form submission via webhook
Extract and validate client information with Claude
Create contact in CRM (Clio, HubSpot) via API
Run conflict check against existing client database
Send welcome email with engagement letter and next steps
Create initial matter/project in practice management

workflows.name: AI-Powered Time Capture
workflows.description: Sync calendar + email + project tools to auto-generate time entries
workflows.trigger: Calendar event ends or email thread closes
steps: Monitor calendar events and email interactions via API
Match activities to client matters using AI classification
Generate time entry descriptions from meeting notes and email context
Suggest billing category and rate
Submit for professional review in time tracking tool
Track approval rate and refine classifications
prerequisites: Time tracking tool with API (Clio, Harvest)

workflows.name: AI Document Drafting
workflows.description: Generate first drafts of standard documents from templates and client data
workflows.trigger: New matter created requiring standard documents
steps: Detect new matter requiring documents from practice management
Pull client data and matter details via API
Select appropriate template based on matter type
Generate personalized first draft with Claude using client context
Store draft in document management system
Notify professional for review with tracked changes

workflows.name: Automated Billing Reconciliation
workflows.description: Sync time entries to invoices — flag unbilled work and revenue leakage
steps: Pull all time entries for billing period from time tracking API
Cross-reference with existing invoices and WIP
Flag unbilled entries and potential revenue leakage
Generate draft invoices for review
Alert partners about aging WIP and collection issues
Track billing realization rate trends

workflows.name: Automated Client Status Updates
workflows.description: Generate and send periodic client updates from matter activity data
workflows.trigger: Scheduled update cycle (weekly/bi-weekly) or milestone reached
steps: Pull recent activity from practice management for each active matter
Generate client-friendly status summary with Claude
Include upcoming milestones and any items requiring client action
Send via email or update client portal
Track client engagement with updates
